hook: Apple Watch can now summarize your conversations

beats.say: The watchOS 27.3 beta adds Siri Recap, which lets Series 12 and Ultra 4 Apple Watches listen to conversations and summarize them. Audio is discarded after each summary.
After two weeks of testing, MacRumors found summaries too brief, with no speaker labels and no audio to check. Long talks, like vet visits, got merged into confusing recaps.
It even summarized YouTube videos. Siri Recap is still in beta and is due with watchOS 27.3 in December.
